name: autoace-api
description: API Lambda: runs, uploads, validation, worker fan-out and results

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && rm -f function.zip && zip -q function.zip index.mjs
